desc: While holding this fan, you can use an action to cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.FSMy6VAjDnXY9vWz]{Gust of Wind} spell (save DC 13) from it. Once used, the fan shouldn't be used again until the next dawn. Each time it is used again before then, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working and tearing into useless, nonmagical tatters.
name: wind fan
